delivery.note: Flat rate per mile, not per pallet
delivery.free_delivery: Free when quantity >= 200 AND distance <= 25 miles

tax.note: Applied to pallet subtotal only, not delivery. Skip if customer is tax exempt.

formula: total = (price_per_pallet * quantity) + delivery + tax; delivery = 0 if qty>=200 and miles<=25 else miles * 3.50; tax = 0.053 * (price_per_pallet * quantity) unless tax exempt
distance_note: Driving distances from the Richardsville yard, rounded. If the destination is not listed, give the pallet subtotal + tax and say the delivered total will be texted after checking distance.
